result.notes: Extracted burgers, Chi'ken burgers and big salads. Skipped sides under 4 EUR (none) and the 4.50 EUR cheesecake dessert (under 5 EUR). Fries, sweet potato fries, nuggets, breaded cauliflower and coleslaw are sides and were skipped as they are not main dishes. Burger extras (cheeze, jalapeños) and dips skipped. All values are estimates; no portion weights are published.

dishes.name: Smokey BBQ Mushroom Burger
dishes.description: Portobello and champignon patty with maple-smoked BBQ sauce, in a brioche bun with vegan mayo, lettuce & veggies.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, mushroom patty ~120 g, 2 tbsp vegan mayo, BBQ sauce, veggies
dishes.assumptions: Patty pan-fried or baked with some oil and breadcrumbs; vegan mayo ~25 g; BBQ sauce ~30 g adds sugar.

dishes.name: Mushroom Pesto Burger
dishes.description: Portobello-champignons patty with roasted tomato, vegan mozzarella & pesto sauce, in a brioche bun with vegan mayo, lettuce & veggies.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, mushroom patty ~120 g, vegan mozzarella ~30 g, pesto ~20 g, vegan mayo ~25 g
dishes.assumptions: Pesto is oil and nut based; vegan mozzarella is coconut oil based and high in fat.

dishes.name: Chili Bean Burger
dishes.description: Black bean patty, spicy homemade chilli sauce, in a brioche bun with vegan mayo, lettuce & veggies.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, black bean patty ~130 g, chilli sauce ~25 g, vegan mayo ~25 g
dishes.assumptions: Patty includes some binder and frying oil; chilli sauce mostly low calorie.

dishes.name: Quinoa-Lentils Burger
dishes.description: Quinoa-lentils patty with a creamy peanut sauce, in a brioche bun with vegan mayo, lettuce & veggies.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, quinoa-lentil patty ~130 g, peanut sauce ~35 g, vegan mayo ~25 g
dishes.assumptions: Peanut sauce adds ~150 kcal, mostly fat; patty lightly fried.

dishes.name: Queen'Noa-Lentils Burger
dishes.description: Quinoa-lentils patty, marinated grilled portobello mushroom, with a maple-smoked BBQ sauce, in a brioche bun with vegan mayo, lettuce & veggies.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, quinoa-lentil patty ~130 g, grilled portobello ~70 g, BBQ sauce ~30 g, vegan mayo ~25 g
dishes.assumptions: Marinated mushroom adds some oil; BBQ sauce adds sugar.

dishes.name: Oyster-Shiitake Mushroom Burger
dishes.description: Gluten-free patty made from lentils, oyster mushrooms, and shiitake mushrooms, topped with pickled onions and BBQ mustard sauce, with vegan mayo, lettuce & veggies in a brioche bun.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, lentil-mushroom patty ~130 g, BBQ mustard sauce ~25 g, vegan mayo ~25 g
dishes.assumptions: Bun assumed standard brioche as menu text says served in brioche bun despite gluten-free patty; patty lightly fried.

dishes.name: Chi'ken Burger Classic
dishes.description: Homemade seitan chi'ken with vegan feta cheeze, roasted marinated peppers, sweet & spicy chili sauce, in a brioche bun with vegan mayo and rocket.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, seitan patty ~130 g, vegan feta ~30 g, peppers ~40 g, chili sauce ~25 g, vegan mayo ~25 g
dishes.assumptions: Seitan is high protein; assumed breaded/fried in oil; vegan feta is oil based.

dishes.name: Chi'ken Guacamole Burger
dishes.description: Homemade seitan chi'ken with guacamole and pickled onions, in a brioche bun with vegan mayo and rocket.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, seitan patty ~130 g, guacamole ~50 g, vegan mayo ~25 g
dishes.assumptions: Seitan patty fried in oil; guacamole ~50 g adds ~80 kcal.

dishes.name: Chi'ken Burger Blue Cheeze
dishes.description: Homemade seitan chi'ken with vegan Blue Cheeze and caramelised onions, in a brioche bun with vegan mayo and rocket.
dishes.portion_assumption: Brioche bun ~90 g, seitan patty ~130 g, vegan blue cheeze ~30 g, caramelised onions ~40 g, vegan mayo ~25 g
dishes.assumptions: Vegan blue cheeze assumed nut or coconut oil based; onions caramelised with oil and sugar.

dishes.name: Quinoa, Berries & Nuts
dishes.description: Colourful quinoa, mixed leaves, goji berries, cranberries, pomegranate, pecans, walnuts, radish, spring onions, and sun-dried tomatoes. Served with balsamic vinaigrette.
dishes.portion_assumption: Large bowl: ~100 g cooked quinoa, 80 g leaves, 30 g nuts, 25 g dried fruit, 30 g vinaigrette
dishes.assumptions: Nuts ~30 g (~200 kcal); dried cranberries/goji add sugar; vinaigrette with ~1.5 tbsp oil.

dishes.name: Chi'ken Stripes Salad
dishes.description: Crunchy homemade fried seitan strips with lettuce, mixed leaves, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, carrots, and radish. Served with white balsamic vinaigrette.
dishes.portion_assumption: Large bowl: ~130 g fried seitan strips, ~250 g vegetables, 30 g vinaigrette
dishes.assumptions: Seitan strips breaded and fried (absorbing ~1 tbsp oil); vinaigrette ~1.5 tbsp oil.

dishes.name: Lia's Salad
dishes.description: Dried figs, apricots, and plums with mixed leaves, pecans, walnuts, and homemade vegan feta cheeze. Served with orange-pomegranate vinaigrette.
dishes.portion_assumption: Large bowl: 80 g leaves, 60 g dried fruit, 30 g nuts, 40 g vegan feta, 30 g vinaigrette
dishes.assumptions: Dried fruit is calorie dense (~150 kcal); vegan feta oil based; vinaigrette ~1 tbsp oil.
